relations: A chrome toy car entering the near track end moves diagonally upward, receding from the camera.
As the car recedes along the track into the distance, its apparent image size shrinks.
Moving toward the upper-right background causes the car's apparent displacement along the track to decrease.
The wooden fence, yellow dandelion, and bare stem remain static on the grassy ground.
caption: The video captures a low-angle outdoor close-up of a bright orange plastic toy car track laid diagonally across green grass. A weathered wooden fence lines the background, while a single yellow dandelion and a thin bare stem sit in the mid-left grass. Dry mulch and scattered grass border the right side of the track, lit by low-angle warm sunlight. A small chrome-bodied toy car with purple and blue reflective tint enters at the near lower-left end of the track. The car moves upward along the orange channel, away from the camera toward the upper-right background. Its image size shrinks as it recedes, and its apparent displacement along the track decreases through the middle portion of the view. The fence, dandelion, stem, and surrounding grass remain essentially static, though their positions shift slightly relative to the image edges. In the later portion, the car appears as a tiny mark near the far end of the track with little further visible movement along it.
